title: Advanced meteorological modeling framework integrating quantum computing and machine learning for hurricane track prediction beyond traditional forecasting limitations
summary: A quantum-enhanced neural model reports hurricane-disjoint evaluation on 2016–2023 forecasts (120-h track MAE 83.7 km vs 312.0 km for a classical ensemble) and a 2024 six-storm holdout (mean landfall error 45 km); this is a source-reported modeling result whose small latest holdout limits certainty.

evidence.ai_role: A quantum-enhanced neural model combines variational quantum features with a classical temporal forecaster for hurricane-track prediction.
